title: Dragonwrath and the Blue Flight
summary: Malygos's death leaves the Blue Dragonflight divided as Anachronos's warning draws mortals into the Dragonwrath quest.
opening: The blue dragons faced a choice of leadership while a darker influence moved near the Nexus. A mortal's search for Dragonwrath became entangled with that decision.
reviewNote: The preview establishes the setup. Verify the Embrace's result and Tarecgosa's fate in released quest text.
